The '''Star of Kala'unn''' was a priceless artifact of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] culture. When it was acquired by a notorious [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] named [[Cada Bliss]], it greatly angered Bliss' old adversary [[Vette]], who decided to get it back. Together with [[Darth Baras]]' [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]], Vette retrieved the Star of Kala'unn from him and later gave it over to her friend [[Taunt]], so that she could pass it to a [[Museum/Legends|museum]].
